t: AIE, Python & Video: Orchestrating Creativity the LPvg Way
s: This article proposes a shift from SEO to AI Education (AIE), focusing on making content 'meritoriously knowable' by AI base models. It advocates for a pragmatic 'LPvg' (Linux, Python, Vim, Git) tech stack to streamline creative workflows, particularly in video production, by leveraging Python scripting and tools like OBS for efficient content creation and orchestration.
sub: Transitioning from SEO to AI Education (AIE) for AI model integration.
Leveraging the LPvg (Linux, Python, Vim, Git) tech stack for pragmatic creative workflows.
Pythonic approach to video editing via automated splicing of short clips.
Utilizing OBS Studio as a cross-platform, FOSS 'category killer' tool for content creation.
